name: SOL S.p.A.
summary: SOL S.p.A. produces and distributes technical and medical gases for industry and healthcare facilities in Italy and internationally. The company supplies technical gases, equipment, systems, and services for the industrial sectors; and produces and distributes gases, such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, carbon dioxide, sulphur dioxide, acetylene, nitrous oxide, gas mixtures, high purity gases, food gases, gaseous helium, liquid helium, gases for electronics, ammonia, combustible gases for industrial use, and liquefied natural gas.
